posts.author: Meghan Montemurro
posts.text: Crow-Armstrong hits a 2-out double but is stranded when Suzuki flies out to shallow RF. The Cubs-Marlins are heading to extra innings here at Wrigley with the Cubs looking for a walk-off victory to clinch a playoff spot.
posts.jp: クロー=アームストロングが2アウト時にツーベースヒット。その後、鈴木誠也がライト前に飛び出してサード。キューバーズ=マーリンズはウリゲリで延長戦へ。キューバーズはここでサヨナラ勝ちを狙い、プレーオフ進出を決める。

posts.author: Meghan Montemurro
posts.text: Pete Crow-Armstrong swiped 2B following a walk in the 3rd and is 1 steal away from becoming just the 7th player with 40 homers and 40 stolen bases in a single season.
posts.jp: クロー=アームストロングが3回の四球後に2塁盗塁。シーズン40本塁打・40盗塁を達成すれば、MLB史上7人目となる。

posts.author: Keegan Matheson
posts.text: #BlueJays lose, 4-3. The arse... is out of 'er.

reply_texts.text: The minute Bateman went down like that, you saw the whole team deflate :(
reply_texts.author: traceeo.bsky.social

reply_texts.text: Feeling like that’s the end of our season :(
reply_texts.author: itsmrmgb.bsky.social

reply_texts.text: And now Scherzer & Bassitt match up again tomorrow!
reply_texts.author: marbyr.bsky.social

reply_texts.text: With Schneider, we've had 6 combined good months (last 3 months of 22 and 25), 6 OK months (2023), and 15 months of "this is 🤮 inducing".  2 swift exits in the wild card series, and one good run in the postseason. 5 years is long enough to see he's clueless.  Hope they fire him before he 💩on 2027.
reply_texts.author: ah-fars.bsky.social

posts.jp: ブルージェイズ敗戦、4-3。残念だ。

posts.author: Andy Kostka
posts.text: Pete Alonso fires the Orioles into the lead with his second home run of the game. That's his 40th home run of the season, and it gives Baltimore a 4-3 lead over the Blue Jays in the eighth. Where would the Orioles be without that guy?
posts.jp: ピート=アロンソが2本目の本塁打でオリオールズをリード。今季40号で、8回にブルージェイズに対してボルチモアを4-3でリードさせた。オリオールズはこいつなしでどうなってたんだろう。

posts.author: Matt Gelb
posts.text: Zack Wheeler struck out the side in the first inning. He's the 96th pitcher in MLB history with 2,000 career strikeouts.
posts.jp: ザック=ウィーラーが初回に三者連続奪三振。MLB史上96人目の通算2,000奪三振投手。

posts.author: Tim Healey
posts.text: News: Red Sox name Chad Tracy their 49th manager: www.bostonglobe.com/2026/09/22/s...
posts.jp: ニュース：レッドソックスがチャド=トレイシーを49代目監督に指名。

posts.author: Andy Kostka
posts.text: Today is Teddy Alonso’s first birthday. Pete Alonso acknowledged Teddy is too young to really know what happened tonight, but maybe in a few years, the two home runs from Pete will be a cool birthday moment to look back on
posts.jp: テディ=アロンソの1歳の誕生日。ピート=アロンソは、テディはまだ幼すぎてわからないと認めつつも、数年後にはピートの2本の本塁打がいい誕生日の思い出になるかもね。

posts.author: Matt Gelb
posts.text: Zack Wheeler has struck out six batters to begin this game. That ties the club's record for consecutive strikeouts to begin a game. Brandon Duckworth did it in 2002.
posts.jp: ザック=ウィーラーが試合序盤で6者連続奪三振。球団記録に並んだ。2002年にブランドン=ダックワースが達成している。
